question: In each of the following questions, a group of three numbers/symbols is given in each option. Identify the group that does NOT follow the same pattern as the others.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/616212e0308a593f26d475848e5e0800eb77e3b6b62a8883f182b3a746bb4159.png] 

The pattern followed here is

Option 1) K11 : I9 : G7

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30e00981a1d673fc90ddc3a1f1bb7ea35d7d394b08eaefbd881c489572363b4b.png] 

Option 2) M13 : K11 : I9

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59ef860491c91fdbd18f98dd10f9f5d2b564f194eabf60a1b5da93f85e215fce.png] 

Option 3) O15 : M13 : K11

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/823f6d0842c0a3c22db979247a952ec775ae10c02a7808aa53dd1b44f6952638.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7902ec074a29925a3843e5b7fef16b70e3a4fc678f5308b54181dc677ba72f82.png]
